seoTitle: AUHSD Academic Calendar 2026-2027 | Holidays, Breaks, PDF & ICS
seoDescription: AUHSD Academic Calendar 2026-2027 with first day, last student day, holidays, breaks, minimum days, PDF and ICS download.
heroSummary: Anaheim Union High School District starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 12, 2026 and lists May 27, 2027 as the last scheduled student day. Spring No-Student Period runs March 22-26, 2027. AUHSD serves grades 7-12 students in Anaheim and nearby Orange County communities.
calendarNotes: Anaheim Union High School District starts the 2026-2027 school year on August 12, 2026 and lists May 27, 2027 as the last scheduled student day. The Student/Teacher Calendar lists 180 student days, 185 teacher days, four quarters, staff development days with no students, teacher days with no students, high-school-only minimum days, quarter and semester minimum days, holidays, and potential make-up days from June 1-June 7.

calendarFaqs.q: When does AUHSD start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Anaheim Union High School District starts school on Wednesday, August 12, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last scheduled student day for AUHSD in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last scheduled student day is Thursday, May 27, 2027. The official PDF also underlines June 1-June 7 as days subject to change to regular school days if needed to meet the state minimum.

calendarFaqs.q: Does AUHSD have a traditional spring break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The AUHSD calendar does not label a traditional spring break. It marks March 22-25, 2027 as non-student/non-teacher days and March 26, 2027 as a holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: When is AUHSD Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: The calendar marks November 23-25, 2026 as non-student/non-teacher days and November 26-27, 2026 as holidays.

calendarFaqs.q: How many student days are in the AUHSD 2026-2027 calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: The official AUHSD 2026-2027 Student/Teacher Calendar lists 180 student days and 185 teacher days.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I add the AUHSD calendar to Google Calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Download the AUHSD ICS calendar file from this page, open Google Calendar, choose Import, upload the ICS file, and confirm the imported dates. The file is a one-time calendar import, not a live district sync.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the AUHSD calendar the same for all schools?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar provides common dates for AUHSD schools, but individual campuses may have different bell schedules, activities, testing dates, finals, graduation details, and events.

calendarFaqs.q: Does AUHSD have summer school dates on this calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Summer school dates are typically separate from the regular AUHSD Student/Teacher Calendar. Check AUHSD or the individual school for summer programs and campus-specific summer schedules.

customSections.label: AUHSD Calendar Overview 2026-2027
customSections.content: The AUHSD 2026-2027 Student/Teacher Calendar provides districtwide dates for grades 7-12. Families can use it to track the first day of school, last scheduled student day, quarters, semester dates, holidays, non-student/non-teacher days, teacher days, staff development days, high-school-only minimum days, and potential make-up days.

customSections.label: Understanding AUHSD Calendar Terms
customSections.content: AUHSD uses several calendar terms that matter for grades 7-12 family planning. These labels help families understand whether students attend school, whether the day is shortened, and whether campus-specific schedules still need to be checked.

rows: A scheduled professional learning day for staff with no students attending.

Check whether campus offices or activities have separate schedules.
A shortened student schedule listed on the district calendar.
Confirm dismissal times with the student's school before arranging pickup or after-school care.
A minimum day that applies to high school students, not necessarily every AUHSD student.
Junior high and high school families should read the symbol notes carefully.
Underlined June dates may become regular school days if needed to meet the state minimum.
Avoid treating June 1-7 as final until AUHSD confirms whether make-up days are needed.

customSections.label: Family Planning Guide for AUHSD 2026-2027
customSections.content: AUHSD families often use the Student/Teacher Calendar to coordinate transportation, work schedules, student activities, testing, progress report timing, grade deadlines, and year-end planning. The calendar uses symbols for different types of no-student days, so families should separate holidays, staff development days, teacher days, minimum days, and potential make-up days before making plans.

groups.label: Childcare and transportation planning
items: Plan around August 10 and October 12 because they are staff development days with no students.
Plan around August 11 and May 28 because they are teacher days with no students.
Check minimum-day schedules on quarter and semester end dates, plus high-school-only minimum days.

groups.label: Travel planning
items: Thanksgiving no-student period runs November 23-27, 2026.
Winter no-student period runs December 21, 2026-January 1, 2027.
Spring no-student/holiday period runs March 22-26, 2027.

groups.label: End-of-year planning
items: Use May 27, 2027 as the last scheduled student day.
Review June 1-7, 2027 because those underlined days may change to regular school days if needed.
Confirm campus-specific finals, graduation, activities, and bell schedules through school announcements.

customSections.label: AUHSD Calendar Research Process
customSections.content: This AUHSD calendar page is built from the official district calendar source rather than from a generic holiday template.

rows: Identify the official AUHSD calendars page and Student/Teacher Calendar PDF.
Confirm the source version and board-approved calendar year before extracting dates.
Review first day, last scheduled student day, quarter dates, semester dates, holidays, non-student days, teacher days, staff development days, minimum days, and potential make-up days.
Convert reviewed district records into the downloadable ICS file and page tables.
Publish the independent reference page with source links, review date, and correction process.

customSections.label: How We Verify AUHSD Calendar Dates
customSections.content:
MySchoolDates reviews the official AUHSD calendars page and Student/Teacher Calendar PDF, compares key dates such as first day, last scheduled student day, quarter dates, semester dates, holidays, non-student/non-teacher days, teacher days, staff development days, high-school-only minimum days, progress report dates, grade due dates, and potential make-up days, then converts the reviewed records into the calendar file used on this page.

The official AUHSD calendar remains the source of record for revisions, campus-specific events, emergency closures, bell schedules, and same-day announcements.
